headerDisplay: Pairs with HomeKit-over-Bluetooth sensors and exposes each one as a Matter device (**Matter only**). Add as many as you like. Run this plugin as a child bridge with **Enable Matter** turned on (and HomeKit off). Nearby devices are listed in the log with their DeviceID; a device must be removed from Apple Home before this plugin can pair with it.

deviceId.title: DeviceID
deviceId.description: The HomeKit DeviceID, as listed in the log ('Found HomeKit Bluetooth sensor … - DeviceID …'). Not the Bluetooth address.

setupCode.title: HomeKit Setup Code
setupCode.description: The 8-digit HomeKit code on the device or its manual. Only needed for the first pairing.

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (minutes)
pollInterval.description: Overrides the default below for this device.

timeout.title: Timeout (minutes)
timeout.description: Overrides the default below for this device.

fastUpdates.title: Fast Updates
fastUpdates.description: Overrides the default below for this device.

temperatureOffset.title: Temperature Offset (°C)
temperatureOffset.description: Added to the measured temperature, e.g. -0.5 if the sensor reads half a degree too high.

humidityOffset.title: Humidity Offset (%)
humidityOffset.description: Added to the measured humidity, in percentage points, e.g. 3 if the sensor reads 3 % too low.

matterId.title: Matter ID (optional)
matterId.description: Only needed after a factory reset: a reset gives the device a new DeviceID. Put the new one above and the old DeviceID here, and the device stays the same in your Matter controller (room, name, automations).

removePairing.title: Remove pairing
removePairing.description: Removes this plugin's pairing from the device, so it can be added to Apple Home again without a factory reset. Turn it on, restart, wait for 'Pairing removed' in the log, then delete the device here.

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (minutes)
pollInterval.description: How often values are read. Devices that signal changes themselves are also read when they change (at most once every 5 minutes). Each read is a Bluetooth connection, which costs the device battery.

timeout.title: Timeout (minutes)
timeout.description: After this long without a successful read, the device is reported as not responding (it keeps its last values).

fastUpdates.title: Fast Updates
fastUpdates.description: Let devices send changes the moment they happen (HomeKit broadcast notifications), instead of only on the next read - what door, motion and leak sensors need. Devices that don't support it keep working as before. Always on for a device with buttons unless turned off for it.

bluetoothAdapter.title: Bluetooth Adapter
bluetoothAdapter.description: Which Bluetooth adapter to use, e.g. hci1 for a USB dongle of its own. Leave empty for the first one (hci0).
